issues.title: Missing anthropic ID during batch creation
issues.error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')
issues.rootCause: Anthropic API response structure changed, ID field is now in a different location
issues.solution: Update API response handling to use correct path for batch ID
issues.context: The Anthropic API response structure changed, and the batch ID is now available at a different path. This fix handles both the old and new structure for backwards compatibility.

issues.title: Webhook not updating batch status correctly
issues.error: Batches remain stuck in IN_PROGRESS state even after completion
issues.rootCause: Status mapping function not handling all Anthropic API status values
issues.solution: Update status mapping function to handle all possible values
issues.context: The status mapping function was missing cases for 'canceled' and explicit handling of 'pending' and 'in_progress', causing batches to get stuck in incorrect states.

issues.title: Token calculation incorrect for batch summary
issues.error: Token usage display showing incorrect values
issues.rootCause: Incomplete aggregation of completion token counts
issues.solution: Update token calculation to properly aggregate all completion values

codeSnippet.before:
const totalInputTokens = batch.inputTokens || 0;
const totalOutputTokens = batch.outputTokens || 0;
codeSnippet.after:
const totalInputTokens = batch.inputTokens || batch.completions.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.inputTokens || 0), 0);
const totalOutputTokens = batch.outputTokens || batch.completions.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.outputTokens || 0), 0);

issues.context: The token calculation wasn't falling back to summing individual completion tokens when the batch-level totals weren't available. This fixes the display by providing a proper fallback.

issues.title: Rate limit errors during high-volume batch creation
issues.error: 429 Too Many Requests during batch creation
issues.rootCause: No retry logic for API rate limiting
issues.solution: Implement exponential backoff retry for API calls
issues.context: Added retry logic with exponential backoff to handle rate limit errors from the Anthropic API during high-volume batch creation.
